detail.longDescription: As an IT professional, I felt a distinct lacking of a real-time tool for tracking down problems in complex systems. I have created Wayseer Desktop as a way to explore more effective ways to explore live systems. There's a very functional free version, and paid options that unlock additional features. I'm curious what you all think of the approach. I'm a systems engineer by trade (with some development experience), not a developer, so I have relied on AI to do the heavy lifting while I request features, report bugs and perform as much manual testing as I feasibly can. There are bound to be bugs... but it is still very young and has a (hopefully) long future in which refinements can be made.
